in_hindi.name: रधेयश्याम
in_hindi.long_meaning: रधेय (Radhey): रधन (radhana) + धा (dhā) = रधन्धान (radh dhān) = रधन्ते (radhante) = रधना (radhanā) = रधा (radhā) = रधेय (Radhey) श्याम (Shyam): श्यामः (Shyamah) रधेय श्यामः (Radhey Shyamah) = रधेयश्याम् (Radheyshyam)

in_marathi.name: Radheyshyam
in_marathi.long_meaning: Radheyshyam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Radheyshyam is a combination of two Sanskrit words - Radhe and Shyam. Radhe means 'worshiped by the divine', and Shyam means 'dark'. So, Radheyshyam translates to 'God who is worshiped by the divine and is dark'.

Radhe means 'worshiped by the divine', and Shyam means 'dark'. So, Radheyshyam translates to 'God who is worshiped by the divine and is dark'.
